data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gabor total 25, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.

in_hebrew.name: גבור
in_hebrew.long_meaning: גבר (gabar) - to be strong, to be a hero, גבור (gavur) - strong, mighty man, hero

in_greek.name: Γαβωρ
in_greek.long_meaning: γαβρός (gabros) - robber, man of strength, Γαβώρ (Gabōr) - name of a place in the Bible, Gerar, the city of the Philistines

in_latin.name: Gaborus
in_latin.long_meaning: from the Greek γαβρός (gabros) - robber, man of strength
